text.text: Production `payment-service` is degraded by overlapping `DB_TIMEOUT` and `OOM_KILL` failures: PostgreSQL connection acquisition is timing out with `DB_CONN_TIMEOUT` and `PSQLException: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved`, while the pod is crash-looping with `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` and `OOMKilled`. `api-gateway` is returning repeated 502/504s on `POST /api/v1/payments`, `auth-service` is returning 401s from `TOKEN_VALIDATION_FAILED` due to `Redis session lookup timeout`, and the `payment-service` deployment is only `1/6` replicas available after `v2.8.4`. Overall severity is P1, with immediate user impact on checkout/payment processing and some login/session validation paths. The single most critical next step is to roll back or pause `payment-service v2.8.4` and restore payment availability while reducing load on `postgres-primary` and stabilizing the crashing pod.

*Issues Identified:*
• *DB_TIMEOUT* on `payment-service, postgres-primary` — P1 (confidence: 99%)
• *OOM_KILL* on `payment-service, payment-service-7d9f84c9b6-rx2pm` — P1 (confidence: 99%)
• *NETWORK_ERROR* on `api-gateway, payment-service` — P1 (confidence: 90%)
• *AUTH_ERROR* on `auth-service, redis-cache, api-gateway` — P1 (confidence: 97%)
• *DEPLOY_FAILURE* on `deployment-controller, payment-service` — P1 (confidence: 86%)
